title: Mover Quote Weekly Estimate Time Trend
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mover:quote estimate_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(estimate_minutes) as avg_duration, max(estimate_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst estimate time for mover quote events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture estimate_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average estimate time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether mover quote tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
